AI Tools · Beta

AI tools

OCR, speech to text, denoise, auto tags and portrait blur. On your device.

Open now

AI Tools has these main features: OCR for images and scanned PDF pages; Speech to text with .srt and .txt export. It opens Any image, Audio, Video, PDF.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with AI Tools

  • Blur the background of a portrait photo
  • Reduce noise and grain in a photo
